attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Push|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character may Push it |!range_small|.

attacks.name: X-Slam
steps: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.
|!wild| |*Throw|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character may Throw it |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Playing Catch
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less and within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Big Brother
superPowers.body: When an enemy character within |!range| 4 of this character targets another allied character with an attack, this character may use this superpower. If this character is within |!range| 2 of the attacking character, this character becomes the target of the attack regardless of |!range| and LOS. Otherwise, after that attack is resolved, Advance this character Toward the attacking character |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Bozhe Moi
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by a |!physical| or |!energy| attack, it may use this superpower. Add 2 dice to this character's defense roll against that attack.

superPowers.name: Organic Steel
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount suffered by 1 to a minimum of 1.|\|Additionally, this character cannot be Pushed by enemy effects.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side.
"Playing Catch" power cost decreased from 3 to 2.
Strike does not have the Concussive Force special rule anymore (see Captain Marvel Cosmic Avengers to see its effect). It can now push Size 4 instead
X-Slam loses the Stagger special rule. It can now throw Size 4 characters instead

Big Brother can now trigger up to |!range| 4 (instead of 2). Its effect is still a taunt when attacker is in |!range| 2. It now allows for an Advance toward effect when the attacker is not within |!range| 2.
Speed increased from S to M.
"Organic Steel" now prevents from being Pushed by enemy effects.
